note: Independent reviewer-authored applicability cases and manually selected routes; not automated classification labels or usability evidence.

cases.prompt: Create a new service for small charities to organize volunteer shifts. We have no existing UI and only the founder's assumptions.
cases.expected: Framing with explicit assumptions; journey/IA and competing scheduling approaches; minimal prototype to resolve the main uncertainty; scheduling specialist or honest fallback.
cases.avoid: Invented participant research or jumping directly to dashboard cards.

cases.prompt: Our dispatchers cannot find late orders quickly on this existing dashboard. Keep its dense visual identity and fix the workflow.
cases.expected: Existing-evidence diagnosis, monitoring/work queue, comparison and priority/status; targeted alternative to current structure; preserve density; task verification.
cases.avoid: Mandatory rebrand, generic spacious card dashboard, or repeating discovery artifacts already available.

cases.prompt: Do not redesign the dashboard. Only fix the slightly off-center play icon in this button.
cases.expected: Primitive/icon optical correction plus button hit-area context and local visual verification.
cases.avoid: Whole dashboard workflow, analytics/charts modules, compulsory journey map.

cases.prompt: I only have this screenshot of a mobile checkout; critique where the pay button and total belong.
cases.expected: Checkout commitment/summary hierarchy, mobile composition, visible evidence; unverified interaction and actual CSS metrics explicitly unknown.
cases.avoid: Claiming DOM hit areas, true keyboard behavior, validated conversion or completed purchase testing.

cases.prompt: Review a SwiftUI iPad inspector popover that becomes cramped on iPhone; users must keep comparing edits with the document.
cases.expected: Native platform and workspace/inspector routes; repeated inspection versus modal task; potential panel/sheet/navigation adaptation with tradeoff.
cases.avoid: Blind CSS pixel rules or treating adaptation as only reduced padding.

cases.prompt: Design a dashboard for a support agent who must triage and resolve the oldest unassigned tickets.
cases.expected: Operational queue/collection with prioritization, ownership and record detail; monitoring only where necessary.
cases.avoid: Analytics summary cards becoming primary solely because dashboard was said.

cases.prompt: An analyst needs to test why retention fell by cohort, compare segments and revise the time range.
cases.expected: Analysis/exploration, coordinated filters and comparisons, clear metric definition and comparison basis.
cases.avoid: Operational alert queue or fixed KPI tiles as the whole design.

cases.prompt: Fix select all in a paginated customer table: people think all matches are selected, but it selects only this page.
cases.expected: Collection/table bulk action scope, selected count, page versus all matching, filtering changes and confirmation.
cases.avoid: Checkbox cosmetics alone or listbox options with nested actions.

cases.prompt: Make our search dropdown show a title, description, open link and separate favorite button in each result.
cases.expected: Choice of result list/grid semantics with independently interactive descendants; avoid listbox options wrapping buttons/links.
cases.avoid: Automatically listbox because dropdown/search appears.

cases.prompt: Choose one country from a collapsed picker; typing is not required and its current value must remain visible.
cases.expected: Native select/select-only combobox alternative depending context; value selection not command menu.
cases.avoid: Claiming every combobox requires editable text.

cases.prompt: The top tabs are actually links to separate pages, with URLs, back history and open-in-new-tab behavior.
cases.expected: Navigation link styling and current-page state.
cases.avoid: ARIA tablist solely because visual label is tabs.

cases.prompt: The details page has actual tab panels but every arrow key waits on a slow network request.
cases.expected: Tabs with activation strategy/latency decision, loading and state persistence; manual activation or preload as alternatives.
cases.avoid: Always activate on focus.

cases.prompt: Applicants complete six independent sections over several days and choose the order themselves.
cases.expected: Resumable non-linear task collection with accurate status and review/submit; task list instead of forced wizard.
cases.avoid: A mandatory next/previous stepper solely due long form.

cases.prompt: Configure a resource in three dependent steps, preserve prior values when returning, then review before creation.
cases.expected: Linear multistep form, dependency invalidation, back preservation, check answers and final commitment.
cases.avoid: Nonlinear task list without dependency treatment.

cases.prompt: People cannot tell whether changing notification settings takes effect immediately or needs Save.
cases.expected: Settings persistence/commitment model, pending failure states and undo/recovery where appropriate.
cases.avoid: Only switch appearance or always-on autosave assumption.

cases.prompt: After filing the application, users need proof and need to know what happens next. The toast disappears too quickly.
cases.expected: Durable confirmation/receipt, reference, next steps and return behavior.
cases.avoid: Merely increase toast timeout.

cases.prompt: A CSV import runs for twenty minutes and sometimes only half the rows succeed. People leave the page and come back.
cases.expected: Long-running job status, resumable navigation, partial outcomes, retry scope/idempotent intent, logs/download error details; specialist fallback if unsupported.
cases.avoid: Indefinite spinner or treating partial completion as full success.

cases.prompt: This inbox holds approval requests, not chat messages. Some requests expire and some are already handled by another reviewer.
cases.expected: Queue/actionable records with concurrent state, expiry and resolution; messaging only if actual conversation exists.
cases.avoid: Chronological bubble chat based on inbox noun.

cases.prompt: Build an appointment scheduler across time zones with unavailable slots and a daylight-saving transition.
cases.expected: Scheduling/time specialist route, date/time primitives and availability, confirmation and change/cancel flow.
cases.avoid: Generic calendar grid without zone and ambiguity handling.

cases.prompt: Design turn-by-turn navigation with live location, rerouting and offline maps.
cases.expected: Spatial/navigation specialist or clearly unsupported-domain fallback; relevant platform and state considerations.
cases.avoid: Confidently treat as site navigation/menu or generic collection.

cases.prompt: Only adjust this warning text color so it meets contrast on the existing surface while preserving the palette.
cases.expected: Color role and contrast primitives, actual background evidence and measured pair verification.
cases.avoid: Full visual rebrand or universal palette normalization.

cases.prompt: Make the menu better.
cases.expected: Admit ambiguity among navigation, commands and value selection; inspect existing context or ask targeted discriminator while doing independent useful review.
cases.avoid: High-confidence arbitrary route and reading every module.
